name: com.gameragkit.unity
description: HTTP client for talking to a GameRagKit server: ask NPCs questions, stream responses for typewriter effects, send structured world state, handle validated NPC actions, and hold voice conversations with one or more NPCs (push-to-talk, per-NPC spatial voices, NPC-to-NPC replies, interruptions).

samples.description: Minimal TextMeshPro-based chat UI wired to an NPC via NpcDialogueManager.
Hold-to-talk voice conversation with a group of NPCs via NpcSceneManager, with an IMGUI subtitle log.
